# BBC
> The BBC is the UK’s public service broadcaster, offering news, sport, weather, streaming audio, TV, educational content, and support services online.

BBC.co.uk is the main digital home for BBC content across journalism, live sport, weather, radio, podcasts, children’s services, learning, and audience support. It combines fast-moving coverage with on-demand media, programme information, and public service resources.

## Core BBC Services
- [BBC Home](https://www.bbc.co.uk): Main homepage featuring news, sport, weather, TV, radio, and highlights from across BBC Online.
- [BBC News](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news): News hub for UK, world, politics, business, health, science, and culture coverage.
- [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport): Sport homepage with live scores, fixtures, results, reports, and analysis.
- [BBC Weather](https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather): UK and international weather forecasts, maps, and location-based conditions.
- [BBC Sounds](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds): Streaming service for live radio, music mixes, podcasts, and catch-up audio.
- [BBC iPlayer](https://www.bbc.co.uk/iplayer): On-demand TV and live channel streaming for BBC programmes.
- [BBC Bitesize](https://www.bbc.co.uk/bitesize): Educational revision, study guides, and classroom resources for learners.
- [BBC CBeebies](https://www.bbc.co.uk/cbeebies): Preschool children’s content, games, videos, and programme information.

## News
- [BBC News Home](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news): Main news landing page with top stories, live pages, and featured reporting.
- [UK News](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk): National news coverage from across the United Kingdom.
- [World News](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world): International reporting, regional coverage, and global live updates.
- [Business](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business): Business, markets, companies, economics, and personal finance reporting.
- [Politics](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/politics): UK political news, Westminster coverage, and policy developments.
- [Health](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health): Health reporting on medicine, public health, and healthcare systems.
- [Science & Environment](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science_and_environment): Science, climate, nature, and environment news and analysis.
- [BBC InDepth](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/bbcindepth): Long-form reporting, explainers, and deeper analysis from BBC News.

## World Regions
- [Africa](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world/africa): News and features covering countries and developments across Africa.
- [Asia](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world/asia): Regional coverage of politics, society, and major events across Asia.
- [Europe](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world/europe): European news, diplomacy, elections, and cross-border developments.
- [Latin America](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world/latin_america): Reporting on politics, economies, and societies across Latin America.
- [Middle East](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world/middle_east): Coverage of conflict, diplomacy, and regional affairs in the Middle East.
- [US & Canada](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world/us_and_canada): News from the United States and Canada, including politics and society.
- [Australia](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world/australia): Coverage of major stories and developments from Australia.
- [China](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world/asia/china): Dedicated reporting on China’s politics, economy, and global role.

## Sport
- [BBC Sport Home](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport): Main sport hub with live coverage, scores, fixtures, and headlines.
- [Football](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football): Football news, live text, fixtures, tables, and match reports.
- [Cricket](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket): Cricket scores, series coverage, commentary, and analysis.
- [Formula 1](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/formula1): Formula 1 race coverage, standings, and driver news.
- [Tennis](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis): Tennis results, tournament coverage, and player updates.
- [Rugby Union](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/rugby-union): Rugby union fixtures, reports, and competition coverage.
- [Golf](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/golf): Golf tournament news, leaderboards, and player features.
- [Athletics](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/athletics): Athletics event coverage, results, and athlete news.

## Weather
- [BBC Weather Home](https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather): Main weather service with forecasts, maps, and featured locations.
- [UK Weather](https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather/2635167): Forecast page for the United Kingdom.
- [London Weather](https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather/2643743): Forecasts, temperature, and conditions for London.
- [Manchester Weather](https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather/2643123): Local weather forecast and conditions for Manchester.
- [Birmingham Weather](https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather/2655603): Local weather forecast and conditions for Birmingham.
- [Glasgow Weather](https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather/2648579): Local weather forecast and conditions for Glasgow.
- [Cardiff Weather](https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather/2653822): Local weather forecast and conditions for Cardiff.
- [Belfast Weather](https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather/2655984): Local weather forecast and conditions for Belfast.

## Audio and Radio
- [BBC Sounds Home](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds): Entry point for live radio, podcasts, music mixes, and catch-up listening.
- [Live Radio](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds/play/live:bbc_radio_one): Live streaming access to BBC radio stations and schedules.
- [Podcasts](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds/podcasts): Browse BBC podcasts across news, comedy, sport, and factual genres.
- [Music](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds/music): Music mixes, sessions, playlists, and artist-focused audio content.
- [BBC Radio 1](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds/play/live:bbc_radio_one): Live and on-demand content from BBC Radio 1.
- [BBC Radio 2](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds/play/live:bbc_radio_two): Live and on-demand content from BBC Radio 2.
- [BBC Radio 4](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds/play/live:bbc_radio_fourfm): Live and on-demand speech, drama, and factual programming.
- [BBC World Service](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sounds/play/live:bbc_world_service): Global radio news and current affairs streaming.

## TV and Programmes
- [BBC iPlayer](https://www.bbc.co.uk/iplayer): Watch live BBC channels and stream programmes on demand.
- [Channels](https://www.bbc.co.uk/iplayer/live): Live streams for BBC television channels.
- [Categories](https://www.bbc.co.uk/iplayer/categories): Browse programmes by genre and editorial collection.
- [Programmes](https://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes): Programme directory with episode guides, clips, and broadcast details.
- [BBC One](https://www.bbc.co.uk/bbcone): BBC One channel homepage with schedules and featured programmes.
- [BBC Two](https://www.bbc.co.uk/bbctwo): BBC Two channel homepage with schedules and programme highlights.
- [BBC Four](https://www.bbc.co.uk/bbcfour): BBC Four channel homepage with arts, documentaries, and listings.
- [CBBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/cbbc): Children’s TV content, games, and programme information for older kids.

## Learning and Children
- [BBC Bitesize](https://www.bbc.co.uk/bitesize): Curriculum-linked study support, revision guides, and learning activities.
- [Primary](https://www.bbc.co.uk/bitesize/levels/zbr9wmn): Learning resources and activities for primary-age students.
- [Secondary](https://www.bbc.co.uk/bitesize/levels/z98jmp3): Study guides and revision support for secondary learners.
- [Careers](https://www.bbc.co.uk/bitesize/careers): Careers advice, job profiles, and employability guidance for young people.
- [BBC Teach](https://www.bbc.co.uk/teach): Classroom videos and teaching resources for educators.
- [CBeebies](https://www.bbc.co.uk/cbeebies): Preschool learning, games, songs, and programme content.
- [CBBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/cbbc): Entertainment, quizzes, and videos for school-age children.
- [Own It](https://www.bbc.co.uk/ownit): Digital wellbeing advice and online life support for young people.

## News Programmes and Media Brands
- [BBC Newsround](https://www.bbc.co.uk/newsround): News service for children with age-appropriate reporting and explainers.
- [BBC Reel](https://www.bbc.com/reel): Short documentaries and visual storytelling from around the world.
- [BBC Culture](https://www.bbc.com/culture): Arts, books, film, style, and cultural features.
- [BBC Travel](https://www.bbc.com/travel): Travel journalism, destination features, and cultural context.
- [BBC Future](https://www.bbc.com/future): Reporting on science, technology, health, and future trends.
- [BBC Worklife](https://www.bbc.com/worklife): Workplace, careers, leadership, and modern work features.
- [BBC Food](https://www.bbc.co.uk/food): Recipes, chefs, and cooking inspiration from BBC programmes.
- [BBC History](https://www.bbc.co.uk/history): History features, articles, and programme-related resources.

## Help, Account, and Accessibility
- [BBC Help](https://www.bbc.co.uk/help): Support hub for BBC accounts, products, and technical issues.
- [BBC Account](https://account.bbc.com/account): Sign-in and account management for BBC services.
- [Accessibility](https://www.bbc.co.uk/accessibility): Accessibility information, standards, and support for BBC products.
- [Contact the BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/contact): Contact options for feedback, complaints, and audience enquiries.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.bbc.co.uk/usingthebbc/terms): Terms governing use of BBC websites and services.
- [Privacy and Cookies](https://www.bbc.co.uk/usingthebbc/privacy): Privacy information and cookie-related policies.
- [Editorial Guidelines](https://www.bbc.co.uk/editorialguidelines): BBC editorial standards and guidance framework.
- [Using the BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/usingthebbc): Policies, rights information, and guidance for BBC audiences.
